senses.gloss:
ITA-2.9.1.13 aṣṭamamāsa-garbha: अष्टममासगर्ः
Eighth month of pregnancy
This month is characterized by frequent joyfulness of the pregnant woman; frequent exhaustion of the pregnant woman; intermittent foetal movements in the womb; intermittent absence of foetal movements in the womb.

ITA-9.6.63 aṣṭavidhaśastrakarma अष्टविधशस्त्रकर्म
Eight types of surgical procedure
Eight types of principal surgical procedures.

ITA-4.7.4 aṣṭasthānaparīkṣā अष्टस्थानपरीक्षा
Eight methods of clinical examination
Clinical examination of eight domains: 1. pulse ; 2. urine; 3. excreta; 4. tongue; 5. voice and other body-sounds such as breathing and heart; 6. tactile examination; 7. eyes and eyesight; 8. build and appearance.

ITA-1.10.1 bṛhattrayī (Carakasaṃhita, Suśrutasaṃhita, Aṣṭāṅgasamgraha, Aṣṭāṅgahṛdaya) बृहत्त्रयी, (चरकसंहिता, सुश्रुतसंहिता, अष्टाङ्गसंग्रह, अष्टाङ्गहृदय)
Major triad of Ayurveda texts
The three principal texts of Ayurveda. Carakasamhita, Sushrutasamhita and the writings of Vāgbhaṭa: Ashtangasamgraha and Ashtangahridaya.

ITA-1.4.1 aṣṭāṅgāyurvedaḥ अष्टाङ्गायुर्वेदः
Eight clinical specialities of Ayurveda
